items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: It's still surprising to me that he could've caught Hawk. Tore Hawk up.

ctx.x: Not just show off your versatility and--
--ability to execute. Tell us a story, and don't let it be a lie. Let it mean something. If it's only one note, like Louis Armstrong, like Duke would do, you know, with that 'lu'?
